source.selection: largest robust nearest-neighbor phenotype distance among basic-dynamics-filtered own trajectories, plus median/persistent/representative controls
source.interpretation: unusual among these 32 own trajectories; not a confirmed rare phenotype or self-awareness result

protocol.learning: habit and schema updates frozen in every branch to isolate the fast causal routes
protocol.controls: stance perturbation with baseline query clamped; picture perturbation with the turn and previous destination restored to the baseline update
protocol.scope: local frozen-controller causal assay, not a new live LLM or a claim about conscious direction meanings
